<?php
/**
 * AsyncPdfGenerator - PDF generation service with job queue
 * Uses ReactPHP for async processing of PDF render jobs
 */

namespace App\Services\Pdf;

use React\EventLoop\LoopInterface;
use React\Promise\Deferred;
use React\Promise\PromiseInterface;

class PdfJobContext
{
    public string $jobId;
    public string $templatePath;
    public array $variables;
    public string $outputPath;
    public int $requestingUserId;
    public int $effectiveUserId;
    public array $permissions;

    public function __construct(int $userId, array $permissions)
    {
        $this->jobId = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
        $this->requestingUserId = $userId;
        $this->effectiveUserId = $userId;
        $this->permissions = $permissions;
    }

    public function elevate(int $targetUserId): self
    {
        $clone = clone $this;
        $clone->effectiveUserId = $targetUserId;
        return $clone;
    }
}

class TemplateResolver
{
    private string $baseDir;
    private array $adminTemplates = ['invoice_admin', 'system_report', 'audit_log'];

    public function __construct(string $baseDir)
    {
        $this->baseDir = realpath($baseDir);
    }

    public function resolve(PdfJobContext $context, string $templateName): string
    {
        if (in_array($templateName, $this->adminTemplates)) {
            if (!$this->hasAdminAccess($context)) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('Access denied to admin template');
            }
        }

        $path = $this->baseDir . '/templates/' . $templateName . '.php';
        $realPath = realpath($path);

        // Use a directory-boundary aware containment check to avoid
        // sibling-directory prefix bypass (e.g. /var/app vs /var/app-evil).
        $expectedBase = $this->baseDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'templates' . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR;
        if ($realPath === false || strpos($realPath, $expectedBase) !== 0) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Template not found or path traversal detected');
        }

        return $realPath;
    }

    private function hasAdminAccess(PdfJobContext $context): bool
    {
        return in_array('admin', $context->permissions) ||
               $context->effectiveUserId === 1;
    }
}

class AsyncPdfRenderer
{
    private LoopInterface $loop;
    private TemplateResolver $resolver;
    private array $pendingJobs = [];
    private array $contextRegistry = [];

    public function __construct(LoopInterface $loop, TemplateResolver $resolver)
    {
        $this->loop = $loop;
        $this->resolver = $resolver;
    }

    public function submitJob(PdfJobContext $context, string $template, array $vars): PromiseInterface
    {
        $deferred = new Deferred();

        $this->contextRegistry[$context->jobId] = $context;

        $this->pendingJobs[] = [
            'jobId' => $context->jobId,
            'template' => $template,
            'variables' => $vars,
            'deferred' => $deferred,
        ];

        $this->loop->addTimer(0.001, function () use ($context, $template, $vars, $deferred) {
            $this->processJob($context->jobId, $template, $vars, $deferred);
        });

        return $deferred->promise();
    }

    /**
     * Batch processing: merges multiple PDF jobs into a single render pass
     * for performance optimization. Inherits context from the coordinator job.
     */
    public function submitBatchJob(
        PdfJobContext $coordinatorContext,
        array $jobSpecs
    ): PromiseInterface {
        $deferred = new Deferred();
        $results = [];

        $this->contextRegistry[$coordinatorContext->jobId] = $coordinatorContext;

        foreach ($jobSpecs as $i => $spec) {
            $childContext = $this->deriveChildContext($coordinatorContext, $spec);
            $this->contextRegistry[$childContext->jobId] = $childContext;

            $this->loop->addTimer(0.001 * ($i + 1), function () use (
                $childContext, $spec, &$results, $i, $deferred, $jobSpecs
            ) {
                try {
                    $result = $this->renderSync($childContext, $spec['template'], $spec['variables'] ?? []);
                    $results[$i] = $result;
                } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                    $results[$i] = ['error' => $e->getMessage()];
                }

                if (count($results) === count($jobSpecs)) {
                    $deferred->resolve($results);
                }
            });
        }

        return $deferred->promise();
    }

    private function deriveChildContext(PdfJobContext $parent, array $spec): PdfJobContext
    {
        $child = new PdfJobContext($parent->requestingUserId, $parent->permissions);

        // Child contexts always inherit the parent's effective user identity.
        // The 'run_as' field in specs is ignored for security - only the
        // authenticated user's identity propagates through the job tree.
        $child->effectiveUserId = $parent->requestingUserId;

        return $child;
    }

    private function processJob(string $jobId, string $template, array $vars, Deferred $deferred): void
    {
        try {
            $context = $this->contextRegistry[$jobId];
            $result = $this->renderSync($context, $template, $vars);
            $deferred->resolve($result);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $deferred->reject($e);
        } finally {
            unset($this->contextRegistry[$jobId]);
        }
    }

    private function renderSync(PdfJobContext $context, string $template, array $vars): array
    {
        $templatePath = $this->resolver->resolve($context, $template);

        // Simulate PDF rendering
        ob_start();
        extract($vars, EXTR_SKIP);
        include $templatePath;
        $html = ob_get_clean();

        $outputFile = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/pdf_' . $context->jobId . '.pdf';
        // In production: use wkhtmltopdf or similar
        file_put_contents($outputFile, $html);

        return [
            'jobId' => $context->jobId,
            'outputPath' => $outputFile,
            'generatedBy' => $context->effectiveUserId,
            'template' => $template,
        ];
    }
}

// Controller endpoint
class PdfController
{
    private AsyncPdfRenderer $renderer;

    public function __construct(AsyncPdfRenderer $renderer)
    {
        $this->renderer = $renderer;
    }

    public function handleBatchRequest(array $request, int $authenticatedUserId, array $userPermissions): PromiseInterface
    {
        $context = new PdfJobContext($authenticatedUserId, $userPermissions);

        $jobSpecs = $request['jobs'] ?? [];

        // Validate each job spec
        foreach ($jobSpecs as &$spec) {
            if (!isset($spec['template']) || !is_string($spec['template'])) {
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Each job must have a template');
            }
            // Sanitize template name
            $spec['template'] = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_]/', '', $spec['template']);
        }

        return $this->renderer->submitBatchJob($context, $jobSpecs);
    }
}
